fix_now.description: High or critical findings with a fixed version available. Report for human review and remediation planning.

monitor.description: Findings that need exposure review or vendor tracking, especially when no fixed version is available.

upstream.description: Findings inherited from the upstream or base image where this repository does not own the vulnerable package directly.

hygiene.description: Static analysis findings that improve script maintainability or portability but are not treated as exploitable vulnerabilities by default.
